muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿سبح لله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض وهو العزيز الحكيم﴾: سبح is a past verb; in لله the lām is a preposition and the Word of Majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سبح﴾; it has also been said that the lām is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant); ما is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿في السماوات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to something omitted which is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. ﴿ما في الأرض﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ما في السماوات﴾; هو is the mubtadaʾ (subject); العزيز is the first khabar (predicate); and الحكيم is the second khabar.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿لم تقولون ما لا تفعلون﴾: the lām is a preposition, and ما is an interrogative noun expressing disapproval and rebuke; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تقولون﴾; تقولون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ما is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); لا is negative; and the clause تفعلون is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿كبر﴾: a past verb.
﴿مقتًا﴾: a tamyīz (specification) converted from the fāʿil (agent).
﴿عند الله﴾: the adverb (ẓarf) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿مقتًا﴾, or a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿أن تقولوا﴾: أن is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; تقولوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن تقولوا﴾ is the fāʿil of ﴿كبر﴾.
﴿ما لا تفعلون﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); لا is negative; and the clause ﴿لا تفعلون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿إن الله يحب الذين يقاتلون في سبيله صفا﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Word of Majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is its noun (ism), and the clause يحب is its khabar (predicate); الذين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause يقاتلون has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; it is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); في سبيله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يقاتلون﴾; and صفًّا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in يقاتلون.
﴿كأنهم بنيان مرصوص﴾: كأن is an abrogating particle, ﴿هم﴾ is its noun, and بنيان is its khabar; مرصوص is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿بنيان﴾; and the clause is a second ḥāl, from the pronoun in ﴿صفًّا﴾.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿وإذ قال موسى لقومه يا قوم لم تؤذونني وقد تعلمون أني رسول الله إليكم﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being "remember when Mūsā said" (اذكر إذ قال موسى); the clause ﴿قال﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); موسى is the fāʿil (agent); لقومه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; in لم the lām is a preposition and ما is an interrogative noun in the position of a genitive by the lām — the reason for dropping the alif of interrogative ما when a preposition precedes it has already been given; تؤذونني is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); تعلمون is an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; as for أني رسول الله: أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the yāʾ is its noun (ism), رسول is its khabar (predicate), and the Word of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi; أن together with what falls in its scope stands in place of the two objects of تعلمون; إليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿رسول﴾; and the clause وقد تعلمون … etc. is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). The meaning: whoever venerates Allah venerates His Messenger.
﴿فلما زاغوا أزاغ الله قلوبهم والله لا يهدي القوم الفاسقين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لما is linking (rābiṭa) or temporal (ḥīniyya); زاغوا is a verb and its fāʿil; the clause أزاغ الله قلوبهم has no grammatical position; الله is the mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause لا يهدي القوم الفاسقين is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿وإذ قال عيسى ابن مريم يا بني إسرائيل إني رسول الله إليكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿إذ﴾ is conjoined to ﴿إذ﴾ in the previous verse; the clause ﴿قال﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); عيسى is the fāʿil (agent); ابن مريم is a badal (substitute) from عيسى; يا بني إسرائيل is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the yāʾ is its noun (ism), and رسول الله إليكم is its khabar (predicate); and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿مصدقا لما بين يدي من التوراة ومبشرًا برسول يأتي من بعدي اسمه أحمد﴾: مصدقًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun concealed in رسول الله, since it is interpreted as "one sent" (مرسل); لما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مصدقًا﴾. ﴿بين﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. يدي is muḍāf ilayhi, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a dual; مبشرًا is conjoined to ﴿مصدقًا﴾, so it is a ḥāl like it; برسول is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مبشرًا﴾; the clause يأتي is an adjective (ṣifa) of رسول; من بعدي is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأتي﴾; اسمه is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and أحمد its khabar; and the clause is a second adjective.
﴿فلما جاءهم بالبينات قالوا هذا سحر مبين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; لما is linking (rābiṭa) or temporal (ḥīniyya); جاءهم is a past verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بالبينات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جاءهم﴾; the clause قالوا has no grammatical position; the clause هذا سحر مبين, made of mubtadaʾ and khabar, is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the object of their saying; and the clause ﴿فلما جاءهم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿ومن أظلم ممن افترى﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; من is an interrogative noun whose meaning is negation, i.e. "no one", in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); أظلم is the khabar (predicate); ممن is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أظلم﴾; and the clause افترى is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿على الله﴾: على is a preposition and the Word of Majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿افترى﴾.
﴿الكذب﴾: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وهو يدعى إلى الإسلام﴾: the wāw is for the ḥāl (circumstantial); هو is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause يدعى is the khabar of هو; the clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl; يدعى is an imperfect verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named); and إلى الإسلام is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يدعى﴾.
﴿والله لا يهدي القوم الظالمين﴾: الله is the mubtadaʾ, and the clause لا يهدي is the khabar; القوم is the mafʿūl bihi; and الظالمين is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿القوم﴾.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿يريدون ليطفئوا نور الله بأفواههم﴾: يريدون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); in ﴿ليطفئوا﴾ the lām is for cause (taʿlīl), and يطفئوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw of the group is in the position of a nominative as fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the lām with its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يريدون﴾; the object of يريدون is omitted, the implied form being "they want fabrication, in order to extinguish the light of Allah". Or the lām in ﴿ليطفئوا﴾ is a connective (ṣila) for emphasis that has entered upon the object, and يطفئوا is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām, and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يطفئوا﴾ is the object of يريد, the implied form being "they want the extinguishing of the light of Allah". ﴿نور﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative by the fatḥa, and the Word of Majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); بأفواههم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يطفئوا﴾, and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿يطفئوا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī), the implied ﴿أن﴾; and the clause ﴿يريدون...﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive.
﴿والله متم نوره ولو كره الكافرون﴾: the wāw is for the ḥāl (circumstantial); الله is the mubtadaʾ (subject); متم is the khabar (predicate); نوره is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is a ḥāl from the fāʿil of يريدون, or of يطفئوا; the wāw is also for the ḥāl; لو is conditional; كره الكافرون is a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl from the preceding ḥāl clause, so they are nested (mutadākhila); and the apodosis of ﴿لو﴾ is omitted, the implied form being "He would complete it and make it manifest".

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿هو الذي أرسل رسوله﴾: هو is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and الذي is its khabar (predicate); the clause أرسل is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. رسوله is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بالهدى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسل﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ودين الحق﴾: conjoined to الهدى.
﴿ليظهره على الدين كله﴾: the lām is for cause (taʿlīl); يظهره is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أرسل﴾; على الدين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يظهره﴾; and كله is a tawkīd (emphasis).
﴿ولو كره المشركون﴾: the clause is a ḥāl; the object of كره is omitted, i.e. "its being made manifest"; and the apodosis of لو is also omitted, the implied form being "He would make it manifest".

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿هل أدلكم﴾: هل is an interrogative particle; أدلكم is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "I" (أنا), and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿على تجارة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أدلكم﴾.
﴿تنجيكم من عذاب أليم﴾: the clause تنجيكم is an adjective of ﴿تجارة﴾; من عذاب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تنجيكم﴾; and أليم is an adjective of ﴿عذاب﴾.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿تؤمنون بالله ورسوله وتجاهدون في سبيل الله بأموالكم وأنفسكم﴾: the clause is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), or resumptive in answer to a supplied question, and it has no grammatical position; تؤمنون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), but it has the sense of a command; in بالله the bāʾ is a preposition and the Word of Majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تؤمنون﴾; رسوله is conjoined to بالله; تجاهدون is conjoined to تؤمنون; في سبيل الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تجاهدون﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); بأموالكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تجاهدون﴾; and أنفسكم is conjoined to أموالكم.
﴿ذلكم خير لكم﴾: ذلكم is the mubtadaʾ, خير is the khabar, and لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خير.
﴿إن كنتم تعلمون﴾: إن is conditional; كنتم is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause تعلمون is the khabar of كنتم; the apodosis of the conditional is omitted, its implied form being "then do it" (فافعلوه); and the object of تعلمون is omitted for brevity since it is known, i.e. "that it is better for you".

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿يغفر لكم ذنوبكم﴾: يغفر is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis of a supplied condition; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يغفر﴾; ذنوبكم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa, and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of the supplied condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
﴿ويدخلكم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يدخلكم is conjoined to يغفر; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; جنات is a second mafʿūl bihi by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); the clause تجري is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿جنات﴾; من تحتها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تجري﴾; and الأنهار is the fāʿil.
﴿ومساكن طيبة في جنات عدن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; مساكن is conjoined to جنات; طيبة is a naʿt of ﴿مساكن﴾; and في جنات عدن is a second naʿt.
﴿ذلك الفوز العظيم﴾: ذلك is the mubtadaʾ (subject), the reference being to the forgiveness and the admission into the gardens; الفوز is the khabar (predicate); and العظيم is a naʿt of ﴿الفوز﴾.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t: ﴿وأخرى تحبونها نصر من الله وفتح قريب وبشر المؤمنين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أخرى is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "He will give you another blessing" (يؤتكم نعمة أخرى), and the clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause ﴿يغفر لكم﴾; تحبون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), but it has the sense of a command [Translator's note: so in the source; this remark seems carried over from تؤمنون in verse 11, and تحبونها here is descriptive, not a command]; the hāʾ is a pronoun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of an accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أخرى﴾; نصر is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "that other blessing is help from Allah", or a badal (substitute) from أخرى if you parse it as a mubtadaʾ; من الله is a naʿt of ﴿نصر﴾; فتح is conjoined to نصر; and قريب is a naʿt. وبشر: the wāw is a conjunction, and بشر is an imperative verb, conjoined to تؤمنون because that has the sense of a command; and المؤمنين is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿كونوا أنصار الله﴾: كونوا is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperative verb; the wāw is its noun (ism); أنصار الله is its khabar (predicate); and the Word of Majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿كما قال عيسى ابن مريم للحواريين﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun); ﴿ما﴾ is a maṣdar-forming particle; ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa; عيسى is the fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma; ﴿ابن﴾ is a naʿt (adjective), nominative by the ḍamma; ﴿مريم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa because it is a diptote; ﴿للحواريين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) ﴿ما﴾; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما قال﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive.
﴿من أنصاري إلى الله﴾: من is an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); أنصاري is the khabar, nominative by the implied ḍamma, in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi [Translator's note: so in the source; evidently something like "and the yāʾ is" has dropped out — it is the yāʾ of the first person that is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi]; إلى الله is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the yāʾ of the first person, on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "turning towards the support of Allah"; and the clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿قال الحواريون﴾: a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿نحن أنصار الله﴾: نحن is the mubtadaʾ and أنصار الله the khabar; the clause is the object of the saying; and it is a case of annexing a descriptive noun to its object.
﴿فآمنت طائفة من بني إسرائيل وكفرت طائفة﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to omitted clauses that must be supplied, i.e. "so when ʿĪsā was raised to heaven, the people split into two groups over him, and a party believed"; طائفة is the fāʿil of آمنت; من بني إسرائيل is a naʿt of ﴿طائفة﴾; and كفرت طائفة is conjoined to فآمنت طائفة.
﴿فأيدنا الذين آمنوا على عدوهم﴾: the fāʾ also conjoins to something omitted, i.e. "so the two parties fought"; أيدنا is a verb and its fāʿil; الذين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and على عدوهم is attached to ﴿أيدنا﴾.
﴿فأصبحوا ظاهرين﴾: فأصبحوا is conjoined to ﴿فأيدنا﴾; the wāw is its noun, and ظاهرين is its khabar.
